name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions, with rule-based pruning, prompt pinning, a summary tier for long text and a decision log.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

toolThresholds.title: Per-tool keep thresholds
toolThresholds.description: Comma-separated Tool=threshold pairs overriding the keep threshold, e.g. Read=0.6, Grep=0.6.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

preserveRecentPrompts.title: Recent prompts to preserve
preserveRecentPrompts.description: Everything from the Nth-newest user prompt on is pinned from pruning, and kept verbatim by the summary tier.

maxPinnedMessages.title: Maximum pinned messages
maxPinnedMessages.description: Caps what the recent-prompt pin covers, for long autonomous turns.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction (either this or the token threshold triggers it).

compactAtTokens.title: Compaction token threshold
compactAtTokens.description: Context tokens at which turn.complete requests compaction; 0 leaves it to the percentage.

summaryAboveTokens.title: Summary tier threshold
summaryAboveTokens.description: When the pruned conversation is still above this many tokens, everything before the newest prompts is summarised by a fork of the session model; 0 turns the tier off.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

resultPreviewChars.title: Output preview for Jev
resultPreviewChars.description: Characters of each tool output (head and tail) shown to Jev when judging it; 0 hides outputs.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

archiveResults.title: Save removed output
archiveResults.description: Write the full output of each dropped call or truncated result to .claude/fast-jev-compaction/ in the project (git-ignored) and cite the file in its place, so it can be read back. Output that looks like credentials is never written.

retries.title: Jev retries
retries.description: Extra attempts for a failed Jev request before falling back.

logDir.title: Decision log folder
logDir.description: Where one JSON record per compaction is written; empty for ~/.local/state/fast-jev-compaction.
